doc: Team roles in the design stations.

director.name: Mission Director
director.goal: Keep at least 10 % of the budget as reserve
director.why: Real missions almost always cost more than planned, and the reserve keeps them from being canceled.
director.simplified: The goals use one margin for every phase, where the standard gives different margins at each review.

cientifico.name: Principal Scientist
cientifico.goal: Cover every science objective and reach ≥ 80 % of the science target
cientifico.why: Without useful science, a mission can't justify its cost.
cientifico.simplified: The goals use one margin for every phase, where the standard gives different margins at each review.

ingeniero.name: Systems Engineer
ingeniero.why: Designs grow as they get built, and margins soak up the surprises.
ingeniero.simplified: The goals use one margin for every phase, where the standard gives different margins at each review.

operaciones.name: Operations and Communications
operaciones.goal: Download 100 % of the data and keep the craft alive for its whole design life
operaciones.why: Data that never reaches Earth is data lost.
